text: Reports that resistance leader General Cordan has defected unsettle the surviving Phantoms. Meanwhile, an impending invasion of the Sci-Rung homeworld creates a chance to penetrate the empire’s command structure and investigate Cordan’s disappearance. Wic pursues both opportunities despite personal loss, but the team’s discoveries reveal a danger to entire civilizations and leave them facing overwhelming enemy strength.
author: Christopher Hopper, J.N. Chaney
